setup.precision: fp16 autocast + fused SDPA attention, batch 8, GPU 0 capped at 2.4 GiB
setup.metrics: outputs clamped to [-1,1]; RMSE % and PSNR on (x+1)/2; SAM deg on (x+1)/2; mean/sd over 16 items x 2 seeds

diagnostics.note: x0_rmse: one-step x0 estimate from x_t = q(x_t|x_true) with true y; x0_rmse_yshuf: same with another item's y; x0_rmse_y0: with y = 0
